svg.title: yolowhtml — STATISTICS × DOM
svg.desc: A cascade: cheap decisions first. Viola & Jones (CVPR 2001) cascade. article? → 86-feature model → rule chain. The model only runs where rules are weak, and it backs off when it is unsure — a cascade in spirit, not a boosted detector. Composite text density. CETD · Sun, Song & Liao (SIGIR 2011). CTD = (C/T) · log_b((C/LC)·(T/LT)). LC and LT clamp at 1 and bad logs fall back to C/T; a proved bound lets pure inline leaves skip three ln calls. Maximum subsequence of prose. MSS · Pasternack & Roth (WWW 2009). s_i = words − 2·linkwords − 3, max Σ s_i. The best run is not the answer: it becomes two features for the tree model, so one long link list cannot fool the extractor. What the characters look like. Shannon entropy · jusText (Pomikálek 2011). H = −Σ_k p_k log₂ p_k over 5 character classes. Punctuation and symbols merge into one class; hand-picked function words feed stop density as features, not as jusText’s classifier. Five tests become one leaf index. CatBoost · Prokhorenkova et al. (NeurIPS 2018). j = Σ_k 2^4−k·[x_f(k) ≥ t_k], z = b + 2^−15·Σ v. A branch-free loop; index & 0x7F over a 128-wide buffer drops bounds checks in safe Rust; 125 i16 trees ≈ 11 KiB stay in L1. Pick the F1-optimal cut. Lipton, Elkan & Naryanaswamy (2014). τ* = ½ · max_S 2Σwp / (Σw + s·Σwp). Expected positives are scaled by s = 0.85; tables and <pre> blocks are kept or dropped as a whole against τ*. Decode a coherent sequence. Web2Text · Vogels et al. (WSDM 2018). ψ = λ_0 + λ_1 / (1 + d_LCA), λ_1 = 1.2. A closed-form switch penalty instead of a learned CRF: blocks 2 tree edges apart pay 0.4 and stay together; 14 apart pay 0.08. Every gain comes with a p-value. Efron & Tibshirani (1993) · Fisher–Pitman. paired bootstrap B = 10^4 · sign-flip test. The out-of-distribution set improved too, and the new model runs at 0.876× the old time.
